effect.name: Photoshop Screen (Background)
effect.description: (The effect comes from the Photoshop) Looks at each channels color information and multiplies the inverse of the blend and base colors. The result color is always a lighter color. Screening with black leaves the color unchanged. Screening with white produces white. The effect is similar to projecting multiple photographic slides on top of each other
effect.author: Foxioo
